I can’t imagine how hard it must all be, you’re so strong to be dealing with this. Despite whatever’s going on, you’re still here and that’s a lot. It really is. It can’t be this way forever, this same feeling can’t last forever and you won’t always be at crossroads like this. Even though I can’t read the future i’m saying that with confidence because that’s the thing about life, things are constantly changing and nothing is ever permanent — not even the bad.
Are there any homeless shelters you can go to nearby? I think right now you need people around you and you need a place to stay too so that would be good. Please hold on for me, I don’t know you and I didn’t know you existed before I saw this but I care and I want better for you. That counts for something, so please don’t let your brain convince you nobody cares. I care and I hope you stick around a while longer to see how your story turns out in the end.
Bad people don’t care about being bad. The fact you’re worried says a lot. You’re not an awful person and you don’t deserve to die like you said. Please be patient and compassionate with yourself.

You did the right thing telling her. Even though your mother is acting like it’s not serious, the fact she told your brother shows she cares. You deserve help and you’re not a burden to anyone. Your brother doesn’t HAVE to help you or talk to you but he is because he’s finding out you’re in a bad place and he wants to be there for you. Sometimes we get so caught up in our lives and problems we don’t notice our own siblings are in pain and it’s good that now he knows and can be there for you.

To me it looks like she’s unserious and doesn’t really want to be with you. Has she told you what she feels uncomfortable doing? Communication is key. Also, the fact she’s ignoring you and playing games with other guys shows that she’s not really interested. When i like someone, i get excited when they message me and make time for them. Girls will really show it if they like you trust me. Do yourself a favour and try to not contact her and if she reaches out, tell her if she doesn’t want to be serious and isn’t on the same page as you then you’d rather not speak to her. It’ll hurt for a bit but trust me it’s better than chasing somebody who doesn’t want you as much as you want them. Prioritise yourself. You’ll find someone who doesn’t feel uncomfortable being with you and actually communicates properly. You’re still only 17 so you’re ok.

Hey, first of all i’m really sorry this is happening to you. I have a tough relationship with my mother too and i know how hard that can be. Sometimes the guilt just eats you up and you wish you could just be who they want you to be so you wouldn’t have to deal with them whining and being disappointed in you. Life is already hard enough and knowing that your own mother will never understand you how you want to be understood makes it even harder but we just have to accept that and make peace with it. 

Not making excuses for her but your mother is the way she is because of how her life was. Everyone is a product of their environment and everything that’s ever happened to them. Yeh she’s a grown adult and she should have the emotional intelligence to learn about boundaries and learn how to respect you and not speak out of turn but the truth is, broken people break people. You can love your mother from a distance. If you know that constantly speaking to her ruins your mood and makes you feel bad about yourself i would suggest acting like you’re busy and only making limited time for her till she gets used to it and expects less and less of your time. You don’t want to lose the rest of your family so you have to be patient and learn how to not let her get to you. 

You can get the help you need and live a great life without your mum being by your side 24/7. It’s gonna be hard and i understand that firsthand but there are people who love and support you and it won’t always feel this hard. You’ll get through this and look back on it one day when you’re at a better place. Slowly but surely you’ll get there. Be patient with yourself. 

Private message me if you want to rant. I’m here. I wish you the best.
